card.name: Words right after a negation or contrast
card.fires_on: Common small words (and, were, a, use, their, different) in English text, often shortly after a negation such as not, no or don't, or a contrast such as compared to. The next word continues a negated or contrasted statement.

modes.label: After a negation
modes.description: A small word follows not, no or don't and continues the negated claim.
modes.example: A force is not required to keep an object in motion. A<< force>> is only required to maintain an acceleration.

modes.label: After a comparison
modes.description: A word follows 'compared to' or 'different' and sets up a contrast.
modes.example: increases the risk of drug-related mortality compared to<< use>> of opioids alone.

card.writes: It pushes toward some Chinese words (e.g. 容易, 不仅) and away from Chinese negation phrases like 没有人 and 绝对不会, so the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words that come just after a 'not' or a comparison in a sentence.
